args.body:
• Tamarack Components newsletter: this quarter's freight pricing is the focus; full article at blog.tamarack.example/2026/freight.
• Main article: spot rates fell 9% while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
• Subscriber companion piece: shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
args.title: Tamarack Components Freight Pricing Summary
